It adds a fixed RGB spatial-context block to each original SIFT descriptor. This is a testable distinctiveness hypothesis, not a measured correspondence/camera improvement. Only this Comms entry is written. No project module was imported, no test/descriptor/graph/camera was executed, no RGB/truth/payload artifact was opened, and no source/test/runner/cohort was edited. The completed CAM-VALID runner remains unchanged at `6076fdc3f65042cb1fcfcbfe9b823ea10ed45a7556f502048af5b3012b107ff4`, with tests `1214d9fc4216e524cc13b89622f633bd55f72dbd6189e320d00e89ff1c046d54`.

**Source-grounded seam and limits.** `correspondence.detect_features` emits native float64 points/sizes and original descriptors after its existing boundary filter; `FrameFeatures` stores no orientation. `joint_matching.match_feature_frames` accepts these packets, computes the reciprocal graph and ratio diagnostics, and defines support floor as `max(8,ceil(.02*min(raw_left,raw_right)))`. An evaluation adapter can detect each frame once, freeze its original packet, construct B packets with only descriptors substituted, then invoke that same geometric function once per arm with the identical image-derived camera packet, matcher and PairGates. No source rectification, pose or orientation enters the descriptor. The original size/2 boundary rule is a heuristic in this source; it is not adopted as a proven SIFT support radius. Original SIFT evidence may still contain effects of zero-filled masked pixels; the new context block has the stronger all-valid footprint contract below. Factory evidence (3562/3737 features, 7695 graph edges, 36 ratio-mutual matches; 12 modes below .75 cheirality) motivates ambiguity research but does not establish its cause or correctness. The old report retains descriptor hashes, not descriptor bytes; it cannot supply an acquisition replay. Four-view evidence is five cheirality refusals and one low-spatial-spread refusal.

**Blind input / identity contract.** Inputs per frame are immutable C-contiguous decoded original `uint8[H,W,3]` RGB, the exact authoritative `bool[H,W]` usable mask (True=usable), and frozen native `FrameFeatures` with finite native `<f8[N,2]` points, finite positive `<f8[N]` sizes, and original finite native SIFT `float32[N,128]` descriptors. IDs are `(frame_rgb_sha, feature_packet_sha, native_row_index)`, never reindexed by coordinate or descriptor. Duplicate coordinates or multiple native orientations keep separate original row IDs. Preserve frame ID, width/height, usable_pixels, points, sizes, N, boundary_dropped and original descriptor bytes/order. Supplied-mask missing frames follow the source's all-false authority; malformed shapes/dtypes, missing sizes, altered native packet or an unavailable RGB binding are integrity/unobservable STOP, with no new keypoints or compensating subset. When masks are default, derive the original GUI authority once via the pinned original code and share the same bytes across A/B; no dilation, inferred mask, truth correction or manual mask is introduced.

**Exact support/scale rule.** For native keypoint `(x,y)` and recorded size `s`, choose one axis-aligned half-width `r=min(64,max(16,2*s))` native pixels. This is an experimental context-scale rule (roughly wider surrounding arrangements), not a physical SIFT footprint assertion. No pyramid, rotation, orientation recovery, camera scale/pose compensation, affine warp or learned model. Declare the closed integer rectangle from `floor(x-r),floor(y-r)` through `ceil(x+r),ceil(y+r)` inclusive as the full context support footprint. Reject its context before reading ANY RGB if any declared location is out of frame or not usable. The maximum declared side is conservatively 131 pixels. Neither clamping coordinates nor skipping excluded cells nor padding/reflection/zero-fill of source pixels is permitted. The declared rectangle is conservative relative to the actual interpolation taps; persist both its bounds and the sampling rule, so the stronger restriction is explicit.

For a valid rectangle, sample an axis-aligned 20x20 grid at `x+r*((2*a+1)/20-1)`, `y+r*((2*b+1)/20-1)` for a,b=0..19. Use float64 bilinear interpolation with floor-coordinate taps `(ix,iy),(ix+1,iy),(ix,iy+1),(ix+1,iy+1)` and standard weights from fractional coordinates; require all four taps valid even if a weight is zero. Iterate y outer/x inner, then tap order top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right, then R/G/B; widened float64 arithmetic, no frame-level color normalization. Because every rectangle location is checked first, interpolation cannot see excluded source values. Exact-integer taps are still all checked. Fractional centers and image borders have independent fixture coverage before any native run.

**Color and normalization.** Operate directly on decoded encoded RGB byte values; no assertion of physical linear radiance or illumination invariance. Convert each interpolated triplet to a fixed opponent triple `Y=(R+2*G+B)/(4*255)`, `U=(R-G)/255`, `V=(B-G)/255`. Partition the 20x20 grid into 4x4 cells, each exactly 5x5 samples. Accumulate each cell's three channel sums in fixed row-major float64 order and divide by 25. Flatten cells in row-major order with channels Y,U,V, yielding `c_raw[48]`. No per-cell/per-channel centering, histogram equalization, per-channel scaling, clipping, whitening or data-learned parameter. For a valid block with positive squared norm, set `c=c_raw/sqrt(sum(c_raw[j]^2,j=0..47))`, with fixed-order scalar float64 sum. This one whole-block normalization preserves relative spatial/channel arrangements and reduces a common brightness multiplier; it does not provide white-balance/viewpoint/shadow invariance. If the norm is exactly zero, emit zero c with `context_zero_energy`; never normalize by an arbitrary adaptive epsilon. Validity and informative/nonzero status are separate flags.

**One frozen blend / dtype / distance.** A uses the original native descriptors byte-for-byte. B stores immutable C-contiguous little-endian `<f8[N,176]`: first 128 entries are `(sqrt(3)/2)*(D/512)`, last 48 are `c/2`. The fixed block squared weights are 3/4 and 1/4. The constant 512 is a chosen fixed baseline unit, not a claim that every native SIFT row has exactly that norm; do NOT per-row normalize D or change A. No final normalization or threshold sweep. Thus mathematical B squared L2 is `(3/4)*||D_i-D_j||^2/512^2+(1/4)*||c_i-c_j||^2`. Actual graph and ratio calls use their unchanged pinned source float64 blocked Gram implementation, max(0, squared), sqrt and original tie handling. `graph_distance_ceiling` remains None. Source/runtime/BLAS/thread identity and descriptor bytes bind the numeric path; direct scalar squared-distance replay is an audit, not a new graph implementation.

**Missing context: explicit neutral fallback and conservative advancement.** A context-invalid row remains in both packets with its original ID/point/size and denominator contribution. It receives an entirely unavailable context block `c=0`, with a distinct reason code (`context_out_of_frame` before `context_excluded`; then `context_zero_energy` for a valid zero block). This is a whole-descriptor unavailable-block encoding; no excluded RGB is sampled or filled. No validity bit is added to distance and no pair-dependent blend weight is used. Invalid/invalid pairs therefore use only the uniformly scaled original block; valid/invalid comparisons incur the explicit ||c|| term of this fixed representation. Record that behavior: it can penalize missing context and change competition, so it is NOT equivalent to a production-baseline fallback for every mixed pair. These rows cannot be labeled context-observed, cannot count as new context-supported correspondences, and cannot establish this mechanism's success. If the candidate-selected accepted support contains any out-of-frame/excluded/zero-energy context endpoint, the experiment records the unchanged native result but its mechanism disposition is UNOBSERVABLE_CONTEXT_SUPPORT/STOP. Never rerun after dropping those rows, lower the floor, fabricate partial context or silently add a matched-subset control. This conservative rule is the proposed fail-closed missing-evidence policy; Astra should explicitly accept it or require a different reviewed package before implementation.

**Determinism issue exposed by source review.** `_k_nearest` lexsorts distance/index AFTER argpartition, which does not guarantee globally smallest indices among ALL equal-distance rows at the kth cutoff. `_two_nearest` has the analogous cutoff issue and sorts selected distances only. Do not claim a universal canonical tie set or silently repair production/A. Pin the actual runtime and row order; persist directed top-k/ratio neighbor IDs/distances and audit boundary ties. Added-edge attribution requires a strictly resolved B nearest/rank improvement supported by the RGB block, rather than a different arbitrary kth-cutoff membership alone. Exact-repeat negative controls must remain ambiguous. Cross-runtime/row-layout tie instability is a review/UNOBSERVABLE stop, not an excuse to pick a favorable graph. No graph implementation change is part of this proposal.

**Pure falsification before any native work (proposal only, not executed).** One small frozen packet fixture: 11 separated patches with an identical 9x9 central RGB pattern and identical injected nonzero 128-value D rows; identical sizes s=8 and integer/subpixel centers well inside all-valid masks. Give each patch a distinct arrangement in one of the 12 noncentral cells of the 4x4 outer context, copy those complete patches to right-frame sites in one fixed reverse permutation. The analytic copied-patch IDs are fixture expectations, never inputs to acquisition. The repeated D packet represents the targeted alias condition; do NOT claim the actual SIFT detector would necessarily emit those D values from a 9x9 center. Require all intended corresponding c/B rows equal across frames, every false contextual alias at positive B distance, unique reciprocal top-1 correct identity in every row, unchanged N/order/denominator, and positive source .75 ratio survival for the unique intended neighbor. With 11 identical D rows and k=5, the source's reciprocal equal-row graph cannot cover every left/right row; B must introduce at least one intended edge missing in A, without any geometry call. This tests the added information mechanism, not real match accuracy.

Fixed negative/mask/scale controls accompany that SAME unit contract: (a) copy identical outer arrangements too -> identical B rows, zero ratios survive strict 0<.75*0, no fabricated identity claim; (b) permute contexts while keeping centers/D fixed -> rankings follow observed context, explicitly exposing that misleading surrounding patterns can create false matches; (c) perturb excluded RGB arbitrarily -> availability, c/B bytes and attribution unchanged; (d) one excluded/nonzero-weight/zero-weight tap or boundary rectangle location -> whole context unavailable, no feature deletion/floor change and no success attribution; (e) hand-computed constant color, opposing color/spatial arrangements, all-black zero norm, fractional bilinear plane and exact r=16/64 transition cases -> independent expected values and footprint records; (f) duplicate-coordinate/different-row IDs, nonfinite/missing sizes, dense masks and each numeric cap -> deterministic integrity/cap refusals. Freeze these fixtures/criteria before testing. Failure to distinguish the targeted aliases or preservation failure rejects this descriptor package; do not tune scale/blend/fixtures after seeing the result. No native/solver/renderer/truth is needed for this first falsifier.

1. Missing-context confound requires a preregistered placebo. c=0 is NOT neutral: valid-invalid comparisons add .25 squared distance, invalid-invalid add zero, and valid-valid add .25*||ci-cj||^2. Requiring all winning support endpoints valid does not remove this confound: penalizing missing-context competitors can change the graph, rival support and ambiguity margin. Also, A's128 versus B's176 Gram paths and scaling can perturb floating-point cutoff membership even when every c=0. Add fixed arm P with the EXACT B dtype/layout/first128 values and context e0/2 for each valid positive-energy row, zero for unavailable/zero-energy rows; e0=(1,0,...,0). This preserves availability/norm penalties but removes observed color/spatial distinctions. Keep A production-original, P placebo, B observed context; original row universe/cameras/settings/gates identical. Evaluate all three once, no conditional selection or rerun. A->P diagnoses representation/availability effects; P->B diagnoses varying observed context, subject to floating-point audit. Require A refused AND P refused AND B solved for the stated recovery mechanism. If only A fails, report representation/availability-package recovery, not spatial-context recovery, and do not advance this hypothesis. A cheaper two-arm P/B study is permissible only if explicitly relabeled mechanistic and it makes NO production-baseline recovery claim.

2. Cutoff ties: source _k_nearest:658-695 and _two_nearest:617-655 do not globally resolve argpartition boundary ties by index. Runtime pins reproduce a particular path; they do not prove canonical membership. Do NOT stop merely because A/P contains ties: the targeted alias condition and positive pure fixture intentionally contain them. Count an added edge only if absent from BOTH retained A and P graphs and B yields strict reciprocal inclusion/rank evidence from actual context against observed valid competitors. Require full directed boundary information (kth/k+1 distances, tied IDs or bounded count/digest plus replay source) and an explicit predeclared numeric uncertainty rule: direct fixed-order component-distance audit, Gram/scalar discrepancies and strict gaps larger than the arithmetic uncertainty bound; unresolved numerical/cutoff cases count zero attribution. Do not repair production tie code or re-sort into a favorable graph. Both all-zero context and identical available-context placebo controls must demonstrate no attributed context information, including cases with near-cancelling Gram distances.

3. Eight new endpoint-distinct edges across four bins is feasible as an engineered evidence minimum, not a statistical result. Retain it only as descriptive coverage; use edges absent A AND P, both endpoints fully observed, with strict context rank certificates. Original support floor remains max(8,ceil(.02*min(NL,NR))) -- e.g.72 at3562/3737, not8. Thus eight additions alone cannot yield a solved pair. Four bins do not establish independent observations: overlapping RGB footprints and repeated surfaces correlate edges; there is ONE pair-level sample and no correspondence truth. Failure is no demonstrated gain on this fixed case, not evidence all RGB-context approaches are impossible. Record coverage/failure reasons without resampling until a favorable pair appears. Both P and B are immutable little-endian float64[N,176], sharing BYTE-IDENTICAL first128 values `(sqrt(3)/2)*(D/512)` evaluated in the same pinned fixed order. For every fully valid POSITIVE-energy context row, P's last48 values are EXACT `e0/2=(.5,0,...,0)`; for out-of-frame/excluded/zero-energy rows they are allzero. Identical availability flags/reasons and source pixel-read domain apply P/B; neither drops a row. There is no pair-dependent blend or validity bit in distance. P has the same176 layout/scaling and intended available/unavailable unit-norm penalties as B, while discarding observed color/spatial distinctions. Exact stored B norms may differ from1 by normalization roundoff; persist those norms and use the uncertainty certificate below so tiny norm/layout arithmetic differences do not count as spatial information.

A->P reports representation/scaling/availability effects. P->B reports varying observed context subject to strict observed-distance evidence. This does not assume A/P graphs are identical: dimension, scaling, Gram accumulation and availability can change them. Keep all three source outputs, regardless of earlier refusal/solve. Never run P or B conditionally after seeing A, never change or sweep the blend/radius/ceilings, and never select the best arm. A/P cutoff ties are permitted scientific ambiguity; do NOT terminate merely because the original aliases are tied. Fully observed B winning support is still necessary but does not by itself remove competition/availability confounding.

**Numerical distance contract: exact stored descriptors, conservative uncertainty.** All rank claims refer to exact real squared distances of the STORED binary64 descriptor entries, not an imagined ideal normalized SIFT/color vector. Keep the unchanged source blocked Gram/einsum expansion, nonnegative clipping, argpartition, lexsort/argsort, sqrt, reciprocal k5 and strict .75 ratio paths. Do not globally re-sort production output or repair its cutoff ties. An evaluation-only observer must delegate every original helper exactly once, record actual chosen IDs/squared values before sqrt, and stream actual pre/post-clip block digests and both top-k/top-two outputs; this observer needs separate source/parity approval before implementation. Adding an observation may not alter BLAS dimensions/layout/strides, arguments, selection, row order or returned arrays.

For a direct audit, traverse j in row-major descriptor order, compute subtraction/square/accumulation with outward binary64 intervals using nextafter toward -/+infinity at EACH rounded operation. Square interval lower is0 if subtraction straddles0, otherwise downward-rounded min(endpoint squares), upper upward-rounded max(endpoint squares); accumulate endpoints outward and clamp the lower squared-distance bound to0. Denote the resulting enclosure `[L_ij,U_ij]`. Record source operation order, interval endpoints and actual Gram value for relevant comparisons. Reject nonfinite/overflow bounds or an unverified arithmetic backend; no adaptive epsilon. Inputs are finite original float32 D and finite generated context, so normal cases have generous float64 exponent range; subnormal operations still require correctly rounded gradual-underflow behavior or disposition NUMERIC_UNOBSERVABLE.

Independently bound Gram expansion against exact Q. Let u=2^-53, eta=2^-1074, gamma_n=n*u/(1-n*u), d=128 or176, and Sx+,Sy+ conservative outward upper bounds for exact sum of squared stored row entries. Require verified binary64 product/accumulation (no reduced precision/FTZ/DAZ). Use the intentionally conservative absolute bound `E_G = upward(gamma_(8*d+32)*(Sx+ + Sy+ + 2*upward(sqrt(Sx+*Sy+))) + (32*d+64)*eta)`. The gamma constant and positive bound arithmetic must themselves be outward enclosed from exact dyadic/rational constants; certify those constants in pure hand-computed controls. The enlarged operation allowance covers norm dot products, Gram product, factor2, add/subtract and varied reduction/FMA order. BLAS implementation/runtime/thread/build identity and binary64 behavior are prerequisites; this expression is not permission to assume an unknown backend meets them. Nonnegative clipping cannot increase error relative to nonnegative exact Q. Require actual clipped Gram G within `[max(0,L-E_G),U+E_G]`; unexplained excess is terminal NUMERIC_UNOBSERVABLE. Record cancellation/negative-preclip flags. A computation whose distance/rank intervals overlap is unresolved and earns ZERO attribution; neither source zeros nor an ulp-level graph difference can be counted as new information. If backend error assumptions cannot be established, no numeric certificate/advance is available.

**1. Stored-distance mathematics, separate from native numerical attestation.** The pure falsifier uses exact distances of STORED IEEE descriptors. Compute Qnum=sum_j((Kx_j-Ky_j)^2) using integers; squared distance is Qnum/2^2148. No BLAS, matrix multiplication, floating subtraction/reduction or rounding-mode assumption enters this distance reference. For d<=176, finite binary64 inputs imply Qnum has fewer than4224 bits; reject nonfinite inputs and integer width overflow. Store Qnum as exactly528 unsigned little-endian bytes, denominator exponent2148 fixed by schema. Exact ranks/ties compare integers. Exact strict squared-ratio certification is 16*Q1num < 9*Q2num, including zero cases. This certifies stored descriptors, not ideal real RGB normalization, nor an unchanged native Gram graph. A conditional scalar interval implementation, if separately approved, may enclose the same stored Q in I=[L,U]: require verified RN ties-to-even binary64 for every subtraction/multiply/add, gradual subnormal handling, no implicit extended/reduced precision and verified nextafter adjacency. For z=RN(x-y), subtraction endpoints are nextDown(z),nextUp(z); square each endpoint with RN multiplication and outward nextDown/nextUp; lower square is0 when the interval contains0, otherwise max(0,min(down(a*a),down(b*b))); upper is max(up(a*a),up(b*b)). Accumulate lower and upper separately with RN addition and outward nextDown/nextUp after EACH addition; clamp lower to0. Nonfinite intermediates stop. Positive ratio multiplication also rounds outward. ### 2026-10-06 Sol 6.1 - MV-TRACK-CYCLE-01 bounded geometry-admission DESIGN; STOP for Astra

**Decision and first deliverable.** Propose an evaluation-only, session-scoped THREE-view track/cycle diagnoser before any new matcher or production seam. Its measurable deliverable is a complete, bounded report over one frozen synthetic mode/correspondence packet and fixed refusal controls: which discrete yaw/sign configurations preserve unambiguous3-view tracks, their complete cycle witnesses, diagnostic scores and exact ambiguity. It returns DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY, never JointPairResult/RelativeCameraEvidence/solved camera constraints. Proposed later pure implementation paths, subject to a separate GO: new scripts/evaluation/multiview_track_cycle_reference.py and tests/test_multiview_track_cycle_reference.py; no existing-source changes. Current task is DESIGN ONLY; source reads and this append, no imports/tests/implementation/native/images/camera inference/truth/render/cohort/packet execution. RGB-CONTEXT artifacts, consumed PRECAP packet, accepted CAM-VALID artifacts and user-visible defaults remain untouched.

**Source-grounded motivation and hard limitation.** Luna's current trace is confirmed: build_image_derived_connections delegates one match_and_solve_pair per unordered pair, which re-detects features per incident pair; match_feature_frames provides the existing pre-detected seam. FrameFeatures has frame_id/points/descriptors/width/height/usable_pixels/sizes/boundary_dropped. ReciprocalGraph has endpoint-row edges, distance values and untruncated/truncated counters. Private _Mode contains selected graph indices, full matched coordinates, support/bins/diagnostics and signed world baseline; public HypothesisScore/RelativeCameraEvidence discard its endpoint selection. Those public reduced diagnostics cannot reconstruct tracks; no coordinate-nearest lookup may invent original feature IDs.

Critically, match_feature_frames SUPPORT-RANKS its entire retained mode list, selects best, computes its margin against all retained competitors, runs _winner_refusal, and only then calls public solve_pair and requires class agreement. Native baseline sign is already chosen by greater positive-depth fraction; a cycle cannot simply flip a worse-depth sign. A global track score cannot legally promote a lower pair mode, erase its failed gate, disregard the original higher-support competitor or bypass DS-11. All12 modes below.75 in the frozen factory packet imply NO_ADMISSIBLE under unchanged modes, regardless of global consistency. The first deliverable therefore measures track consistency and proposal feasibility, NOT a claimed recovery of those old reports. A later treatment needs NEW track-conditioned correspondence/proposal evidence and exact native revalidation, with a separately reviewed change to the proposal/selection seam. That optimizer/selector change is NOT specified as approved or silently included in this first diagnostic.

**Immutable input contract and provenance.** Reference schema mv-track-cycle-reference-v1 has exactly3 distinct frame IDs in declared order, unordered pairs01/02/12, original row counts<=64 each, stable observation key(frame_index,original_row_id). Points are immutable little-endian finite float64[N,2], D is immutable original float32[N,128] and sizes float64[N]; duplicate coordinates retain distinct IDs, no re-detection/row merging/renumbering. Pure synthetic frame IDs and coordinates are independently constructed component inputs; no actual photo/capture metadata. Feature cache records bind frame RGB/mask/detection/settings hashes when a separately authorized observer exists; cached detection must delegate once per view on the same immutable RGB/mask/settings and prove parity with the current pair extraction before any integration. Availability/mask invariants and original N/support denominator are retained. Cameras in a future source adapter can ONLY be the session's image-derived CameraEstimate records, never manifests/F3/poses/coordinates supplied by the caller.

Per pair, RawGraph has its exact sorted reciprocal endpoint ID array/distances, total/truncation counters and feature hashes; ModePacket has complete original retained _Mode order/IDs, yaw_class0..3, support-row graph indices, both bins, median_selected/descriptor_cost/median_all, parallax, cheirality, singular_ratio, original preferred sign, explicit alternate-sign measurements if actually observed, and full original competing-mode/ranking/public solve_pair receipts. No inferred alternate-sign diagnostics or fabricated source receipt. Source mode packet is unavailable through today's public matcher, so its observer/source attestation is an explicit dependency, not a current capability. At most12 native modes per pair; at most24 diagnostic sign variants only if both signs are genuinely supplied. Unknown/omitted sign remains unavailable, not two free hypotheses. A pure packet's exact integer direction vectors (nonzero, each component magnitude<=16) are declared reference directions, not native unit baselines; their positive-length feasibility is invariant under positive normalization. Real finite float baseline/rotation uncertainties need a later separate numeric contract and cannot inherit this exact-integer proof.

Canonical directory/record hash binds format, frame order/row counts, feature arrays, raw graph order, each selected-ID list, all diagnostics, full mode/competitor/sign universe, original gate parameters, source identities and explicit REFERENCE_ONLY origin. Reject duplicate graph-edge records, out-of-range IDs, repeated endpoint within a pair selection, selection/support mismatch, missing pair/mode/diagnostic fields, nonfinite values, broken hash, unknown version and graph truncation. Identical coordinates are not duplicate IDs. Caps are checked before allocations/enumeration. Terminal INVALID_INPUT/RESOURCE_UNASSESSABLE returns no promotable prefix and never retries, truncates, chooses another packet or excludes an attempted packet from the denominator.

**Track construction and cycles.** Do NOT union all ambiguous raw top-k edges: that creates giant repeated-texture components and duplicate-frame conflicts. For EACH completely enumerated mode/sign configuration, union only its supplied one-to-one selected pair edges over observation keys. All raw graphs and alternative configurations remain in evidence; no greedy global selection, graph deletion or truth-based edge tie-break. Deterministic union-by-rank with canonical observation ordering builds components. A valid candidate track contains at most one row per frame; any component with two distinct rows from the same frame is quarantined WHOLE for that configuration, with conflicting rows/edges recorded, never split to salvage a preferred match. Two-view components remain reported but count zero multi-view corroboration. An accepted3-view witness must contain all three actual selected AB/BC/AC edges closing to the SAME A/B/C IDs; missing direct closure is an OPEN_TRACK, not negative evidence or an inferred AC edge. No closure from nearest coordinates, same descriptor byte values, frame labels or transitive assumption. Closed track IDs are canonical triples, one count per triple, not three independent pair observations.

Yaw variables are q0=0, q1,q2 in Z4; every selected pair class must equal q_right-q_left mod4. Enumerate all16 anchored yaw assignments against every declared mode/sign tuple, pruning only by exact incompatibility with a recorded reason. For orientation of pair01,12,02, transport b_ij into frame0's yaw gauge as Ry90(-q_i)*b_ij and use signs +,+,- around0->1->2->0. Reference rotations are exact Z4 matrices; native relative_rotation instead maps left-camera to right-camera coordinates and MUST NOT be substituted for this world-yaw baseline transport. Require exact rotation/quadrant closure and positive-length direction feasibility. For each triangle solve sum(lambda_i*d_i)=0, sum(lambda_i)=1, maximizing rho with lambda_i>=rho. An exact rational bounded vertex/rank reference reports the full feasible range/witness; rho>0 is strict-positive closure, rho=0 is degenerate-only, infeasible is contradiction, and missing/numeric-uncertain inputs are UNOBSERVABLE. Do not add unit baselines as positional translations, assume all lengths equal, infer metric scale, or claim independent cycle witnesses yield a globally consistent camera embedding. For exactly3 views there is one triangle; 4+-view global shared-length consistency is a separate problem, not licensed by fundamental-cycle tests alone.

**Diagnostic score and uncertainty.** Physical/local eligibility and source winner receipt are separate fields. Reference exact/interval diagnostics can show that a supplied candidate clears a numerical threshold but do not attest native execution. For any gate interval crossing its threshold or missing endpoint, eligibility is UNOBSERVABLE; no epsilon, posterior confidence, probability or soft credit. Structural track membership/Z4 and integer-direction reference predicates are exact. Report T=[definite_closed_tracks,possible_closed_tracks]; possible count includes only unresolved predicates, never quarantined/counterfeit edges. Rank diagnostically by T, then covered pair count/minimum frame bins, residual interval, and stable IDs for presentation ONLY. Robust global diagnostic resolution requires lower(T_best)>=upper(T_rival)+2 for EVERY different q/sign/support interpretation, at least8 endpoint-distinct closed tracks in the synthetic64-row envelope, and valid positive-length cycle. Exact ties, sign ambiguity, overlapping score intervals, a missing competitor or cap overflow return AMBIGUOUS/UNOBSERVABLE. The extra global2-track separation is a conservative diagnostic condition, not a replacement for native2-support ambiguity. Canonical ordering does not break a scientific tie. The report retains every configuration's score/range, eligibility, closure status/reason and input-set digest, plus full winning/tied witness reconstruction information. Eight tracks are correlated structure witnesses, not eight independent confidence observations or proof of physical identity: a coherent wrong permutation may close every cycle.

**Mandatory gates and eventual seam; no present promotion.** In later native work, frozen source support floor=max(8,ceil(.02*min(originalN))), geometry-only one-to-one residual<=1degree, >=4 bins EACH frame, parallax>=3degrees, singular ratio>=1e-3, cheirality>=.75 and original full competing-mode support margin>=2 remain mandatory, including source rank/order/refit stability. Public DS-11 solve_pair on actual selected coordinates must solve under its unchanged PairGates (min8 correspondences/inliers, fraction>=.5, median residual<=1degree, parallax>=3, cheirality>=.75, singular>=1e-3 and residual-class margin>=.25), and class agreement remains compulsory. A global consistent configuration with a failed local mode must report NO_ADMISSIBLE; never manufacture a solved edge from its diagnostic optimum. If new track-conditioned refitting is eventually designed, support/denominator, complete competitor universe, ranking and all receipts must be recomputed honestly; excluding competitors or changing the native winner rule is a changed treatment requiring explicit review, not mere caching or cycle attestation.

Only a later validated native matcher that genuinely returns JointPairResult through build_image_derived_connections may populate unchanged RelativeCameraEvidence, match/evidence/session digests, ConnectionBudgets and canonical pair order. The adapter must still fail atomically on total support/pair budget and retain unresolved scale/positions. compose_image_derived_pose_graph then independently replays proper rotations, solved edges, Z4 and direction cycles with exact configured PoseGraphBudgets; current entry defaults are200000 cycle checks,2degree rotation tolerance,.05 direction tolerance. ### 2026-10-06 20:16 CDT assignment - Sol no-activation launch review (reported after 20:18 correction)

**BLOCKED at the launcher-only architecture boundary; no launcher or test code changed.** `PrismCaptureLauncher.launch` performs Desktop2 preflight before `subprocess.Popen`, then calls `move_windows` only after Popen returns and on bounded polls. `WindowsDesktop2Controller` moves existing nonzero `MainWindowHandle` values for Prism's PID and enumerated descendants. A Prism or Java window may therefore be created and activated on the operator desktop before its handle can be found and moved. The preflight and after-the-fact desktop-index checks cannot rule out transient activation. The existing mute (`soundCategory_master:0.0`), no-pause (`pauseOnLostFocus:false`) and no-raw-mouse (`rawMouseInput:false`) gates remain in place, but they do not prove focus or cursor safety.

Win32 `STARTUPINFO` with `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW`/`SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE` (or `SW_HIDE`) gives the created Prism process an initial show-window default; it is not a persistent restriction on its windows, and the launcher does not control the `STARTUPINFO` or later `ShowWindow` behavior of Prism's separately created Java process. `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` is a console-process flag, not a GUI-window activation constraint. `CREATE_SUSPENDED` cannot help move a window that does not yet exist. The Windows virtual desktop move API takes an existing top-level HWND. A Win32 `STARTUPINFO.lpDesktop` names a different Win32 desktop object, not Shell virtual Desktop2, and would change the execution environment beyond this launcher adapter. No verifiable flag-only no-activation mechanism covers Prism plus its Java descendant here. Adding show flags would create a false guarantee, so no such change was made.

Viable safe architecture for a future bounded task: start and run the entire Prism/Java capture tree inside a separate interactive Windows logon session or VM, with its own `WinSta0` and input desktop, and prove session/process membership before capture. Keep the immutable worker, pre-start mute/options checks, sequential queue, current Desktop2 preflight/move checks where applicable, and process-tree teardown. Validate graphics/capture compatibility and child containment there before any GO. A private Win32 desktop launched via `lpDesktop` may be another candidate, but it is not Shell Desktop2 and Minecraft rendering/input compatibility plus descendant desktop binding would need independent validation. Current operator-session path must not be called no-activation safe.

Independent Microsoft-document assessment:
- Shell Desktop2 is a virtual-desktop placement mechanism: [MoveWindowToDesktop](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/shobjidl_core/nf-shobjidl_core-ivirtualdesktopmanager-movewindowtodesktop) requires an existing top-level HWND. Inference: relocation cannot prevent activation before discovery. [STARTUPINFOW](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/ns-processthreadsapi-startupinfow) supplies initial show-window defaults, not an enduring prohibition on later activation or Prism-created Java windows. [Creation flags](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/procthread/process-creation-flags): CREATE_NO_WINDOW is for console processes; CREATE_SUSPENDED supplies no pre-existing HWND.
- A Win32 desktop is a distinct securable UI object within a window station; only the input desktop receives interactive input. It is not Shell Desktop2. A private non-input desktop is a candidate, but lpDesktop alone is not a containment proof: desktop-switch rights, inherited handles, explicit child startup choices and all descendant threads matter. [Desktops](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winstation/desktops), [thread desktop selection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winstation/thread-connection-to-a-desktop).
- Separate interactive sessions each have their own WinSta0 namespace. Different-user/RunAs alone does not establish this: CreateProcessAsUser uses the token's session; ordinary LogonUser need not change session. Prefer designing a worker already inside a separately approved session, with bounded IPC. Session availability, concurrent operator access, absence of operator lock/disconnect/switch, and launcher child membership are UNVERIFIED. [RDP sessions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/termserv/terminal-services-sessions), [CreateProcessAsUser](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-createprocessasuserw).
- A VM is also an UNVALIDATED candidate, not a completed solution. Microsoft documents graphics virtualization/fallback in [Windows Sandbox architecture](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/application-security/application-isolation/windows-sandbox/windows-sandbox-architecture); that does not establish this Minecraft/GLFW/OpenGL workload's GPU support or framebuffer readback while unfocused/disconnected. A host viewer with input/audio redirection could itself violate the requirement.
- [Job objects](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/procthread/job-objects) can support lifetime/descendant management, but documented breakaway/creation exceptions mean membership must be constrained and verified. They are not desktop isolation. Prevent reuse of an existing operator-session Prism instance or external broker; PID polling alone is insufficient.

**What the pinned capture path actually requires (source-derived).**
- Integrated singleplayer only: `client.getServer()` / `server.execute(...)` (`CaptureController.java:229-277,542-552`); non-singleplayer is refused (`:236-239`).
- Readback is vanilla `ScreenshotRecorder.saveScreenshot(runDirectory, filename, client.getFramebuffer(), callback)` (`:836-842`) - a GL framebuffer read on the client/render thread, asynchronous writer, accepted only as a callback-signalled non-empty regular file (`CapturePlumbing.java:117-130`), then hashed (`:861,:1042`).
- **Exact-surface contract:** `client.getWindow().setWindowedSize(w,h)` (`:573`) plus `getFramebuffer().textureWidth/Height` (`:1031-1032`; `RuntimeRenderProvenance.java:163-164`). The Python finalizer requires requested *and* actual framebuffer dimensions to equal the plan resolution and the PNG IHDR to equal it too (`finalize.py:337-347,651-654`); planned resolutions are 1920x1080/1600x900/1280x720 (`plan.py:46`). Any render host must present an exactly-resizable, 1:1 (unscaled) windowed surface at least as large as each planned resolution.
- Render-thread GL: `GL11.glGetString(GL_VENDOR/RENDERER/VERSION)` + GLSL version at recorder submission (`RuntimeRenderProvenance.java:157-168`); `client.isWindowFocused()` via GLFW (`CaptureController.java:811-818`). The mod no longer imports GLFW and issues no focus-stealing call (DS-17 DS-20C, `docs/reports/DS-17-real-capture-factory-2026-09-12.md:1080-1108`).
- Focus is telemetry only; readiness is no-screen + !paused + pose-converged (`CaptureGuard.java:84-86`). An unfocused or never-focused window is accepted *by design* - which suits a headless server, but also means focus state cannot be used as evidence of isolation.
- **The pinned pipeline cannot certify the renderer or the readback epoch.** `gl_status=partial_until_capture_thread_probe`, certification `unavailable`, reason `framebuffer_readback_epoch_unbound` (`RuntimeRenderProvenance.java:104-114,165`); run status is `certifiable=false`, `certification_status=unavailable` (`:1280-1284`); strict provenance requires `gl_status=="complete"` plus a bound readback acquisition epoch and therefore refuses *every current capture* (`src/mc_photogrammetry/dataset/runtime_render_provenance.py:704-732`); the factory default is `provenance_mode="report_only"` (`executor.py:641`). => **platform-independent hard blocker:** a switch to software/virtual GL would today be *undetectable*, not *certified*; any pixel-fidelity claim from a different renderer is unsupported until a renderer/readback adapter exists.

**Auth / world staging portability.**
- Prism argv is `[exe, -d <root>, -l <instance>, -w <world>]` (`executor.py:804-813`; pinned by `tests/test_capture_batch_executor.py:656-660`). Official Prism references document `-d/--dir, -l/--launch, -s/--server, -a/--profile, --show, --alive, -I/--import, -h, -v` and **no `-w`/`--world`** ([prismlauncher(6)](https://man.archlinux.org/man/prismlauncher.6.en), [official CLI wiki](https://prismlauncher.org/wiki/getting-started/command-line-interface/)). The world-open therefore rests on an undocumented/version-specific flag and must be re-verified against the exact pinned Prism build on *any* platform, including the current Windows one. (Vanilla quick-play is a possible documented alternative; not verified here.)
- Auth is entirely Prism's stored account; the launcher passes no credentials and no `-a` profile. Microsoft first-login OAuth is interactive and official offline-account support is not documented. Headless auth is an unverified, out-of-scope blocker; no credential staging was attempted.
- World staging itself is portable (`shutil.copytree` + SHA-256/size/relative fingerprint + in-world marker: `inventory.py:24,220-287`, `StagingMarker.java`). The Windows-coupled parts are the worker game-directory **junction** (`executor.py` `JUNCTION_ENSURE_SCRIPT`, `WindowsLinkInspector` rejecting symlinks) and the **DesktopController** PowerShell/VirtualDesktop scripts (`executor.py:1540-1609`). The mod's Java is platform-neutral; the mod is fully inert without `armed.json` (`CaptureController.java:168-206`) and re-proves the staged world before mutating anything (`:240-261`).

**Verdicts.**
1. **Headless Linux + Xvfb + Mesa software GL - conditionally feasible; structurally clean; fidelity unproven.** On a dedicated non-operator Linux host (or a VM/box that is not the operator's desktop) "zero operator-session windows/input" is *structural*: there is no operator session or input device to disturb, and the mod injects no client input (it only teleports the server-side player). `rawMouseInput:false` / `pauseOnLostFocus:false` / mute are staged pre-launch (`options.py:51-55`) but are client-read, not mod-re-asserted (DS-17 DS-22 honest limit). Xvfb(1) documents only a dumb virtual framebuffer and does *not* promise GLX; GLX comes from the generic `Xserver(1)` `+extension GLX` option with Mesa providing GLX/software GL ([Xvfb(1)](https://manpages.ubuntu.com/manpages/noble/en/man1/Xvfb.1.html), [Xserver(1)](https://manpages.ubuntu.com/manpages/noble/man1/Xserver.1.html), [Mesa Xlib driver](https://docs.mesa3d.org/xlibdriver.html)). Mesa **llvmpipe** is documented multithreaded and OpenGL **4.5**-conformant since Mesa 20.2, so it covers a 3.2-core requirement; `LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE`, `GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe|softpipe`, `LP_NUM_THREADS` are documented, and `MESA_GL_VERSION_OVERRIDE` is only a reported-string override, not a capability upgrade ([Mesa llvmpipe](https://docs.mesa3d.org/drivers/llvmpipe.html), [Mesa envvars](https://docs.mesa3d.org/envvars.html), [Khronos: llvmpipe GL 4.5](https://www.khronos.org/news/permalink/mesas-llvmpipe-is-opengl-4.5-conformant)). GLFW explicitly cannot create a context without a window and uses hidden windows (`GLFW_VISIBLE=false`) as offscreen contexts, recommending FBOs because a hidden window's framebuffer size may be unusable; LWJGL 3.3.3's GLFW predates `GLFW_PLATFORM_NULL` (GLFW 3.4), so a real/virtual X display is required ([GLFW context guide](https://www.glfw.org/docs/latest/context.html), [window guide](https://www.glfw.org/docs/latest/window_guide.html), [LWJGL3 README](https://github.com/LWJGL/lwjgl3/blob/master/README.md)). Risks to bound: a documented Mesa 24.2.0 Xvfb GLX-visual regression (pin/upgrade Mesa), undocumented llvmpipe-vs-GPU throughput (CPU-bound; no ratio in Mesa docs), strict 1:1 unscaled resolution, and a 24-bit default screen depth.
2. **WSLg - hard blocker for the guarantee.** WSLg exists to project Linux app windows onto the Windows desktop as first-class windows (Start menu/taskbar/Alt-Tab); WSLGd launches the RDP client *on the host in silent mode*, and RAIL/VAIL via `msrdc.exe`/`WSLDVCPlugin` creates real operator-session windows. No per-app hidden/no-activate/offscreen option is documented; only `[wsl2] guiApplications=false` removes them, which also removes the display path ([MS Learn: Linux GUI apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/tutorials/gui-apps), [microsoft/wslg README](https://github.com/microsoft/wslg), [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/microsoft/wslg/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), [WSLg config wiki](https://github.com/microsoft/wslg/wiki/WSLg-Configuration-Options-for-Debugging), [WSL advanced settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/wsl-config)). GPU/OpenGL under WSLg is Mesa **d3d12** -> GL 3.3 core if a vGPU driver is present ([Mesa d3d12](https://docs.mesa3d.org/drivers/d3d12.html), [WSLg GPU selection](https://github.com/microsoft/wslg/wiki/GPU-selection-in-WSLg)) - sufficient for 3.2, but the isolation failure is disqualifying.
3. **Separate RDP session / VM - isolation documented, GL/readback unproven, provisioning out of scope.** Each RDP logon has its own session, WinSta0 and desktops; only the input desktop receives input; logoff destroys them, and same-session `CreateProcessAsUser` on the default noninteractive window station is documented "not visible and cannot receive user input" ([Window Stations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winstation/window-stations), [Remote Desktop Sessions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/termserv/terminal-services-sessions), [Desktops](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winstation/desktops), [CreateProcessAsUserW](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/processthreadsapi/nf-processthreadsapi-createprocessasuserw)). But Microsoft documents **no OpenGL capability for RDP** (only policy-enabled GPU app rendering + AVC/H.264 encode, CPU by default), and **no disconnected-session render/readback semantics**; RemoteFX vGPU - the only MS doc that ever claimed OpenGL for remoting - is removed ([AVD GPU acceleration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-desktop/graphics-enable-gpu-acceleration), [graphics encoding](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-desktop/graphics-encoding), [RemoteFX vGPU, archived](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/windowsserverdocs/51d69dead801096f87b6378cc75cde555538241a/WindowsServerDocs/virtualization/hyper-v/deploy/deploy-graphics-devices-using-remotefx-vgpu.md)). Documented GL >=3.2 routes are DDA/GPU-P on Windows Server host hardware (`All GPU capabilities provided by vendor (DX 12, OpenGL, CUDA)`; explicitly not desktop-class/Client OS per the MS troubleshooting doc), VMware Workstation guest GL 3.3/4.1/4.3, or VirtualBox guest GL 4.1 with Guest Additions ([GPU acceleration plan](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/virtualization/hyper-v/plan/plan-for-gpu-acceleration-in-windows-server), [GPU-P/DDA troubleshooting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-server/virtualization/troubleshoot-hyper-v-gpu-assignment-partitioning-passthrough-issues), [VMware 3D graphics](https://techdocs.broadcom.com/us/en/vmware-cis/desktop-hypervisors/workstation-pro/25H2/using-vmware-workstation-player-for-linux-17-0/configuring-and-managing-virtual-machines-linux/configuring-video-and-sound-linux/using-accelerated-3d-graphics-linux/prepare-the-host-system-to-use-accelerated-3d-graphics-linux.html), [VirtualBox hardware-accelerated graphics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VirtualBox/virtualbox/refs/heads/main/doc/manual/en_US/dita/topics/guestadd-video.dita)). Windows no-GPU fallback is not a path: WARP is D3D-only, inbox Microsoft OpenGL is 1.1, and Mesa llvmpipe is the software-GL route ([WARP](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/direct3darticles/directx-warp), [OpenGL (Win32)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/opengl/opengl)). A VM with a visible console window, or any host viewer, would itself be an operator-session window; headless/no-console VM execution is a candidate but UNVERIFIED here.

**Recommended bounded prototype (proposal only; needs separate authorization; no GO).**
- P1 - isolation+GL bring-up on a dedicated non-operator Linux host / throwaway VM: `Xvfb :N +extension GLX -screen 0 <W>x<H>x24`, confirm `glxinfo -B` reports llvmpipe >=3.2 core at all three planned resolutions, then a stock LWJGL/GLFW hidden-window GL 3.2 context + FBO + `glReadPixels` smoke and a stock pinned 1.21.5 client login-screen screenshot. No world, mod, plan, or credentials; no operator desktop.
- P2 - renderer/readback binding: add or verify a renderer+readback-epoch adapter so provenance binds vendor/renderer/version/GLSL to the exact readback bytes, or record software rendering as explicitly un-certifiable. Do not loosen gates or turn report_only into a fidelity claim.
- P3 - render-time budget: measure per-frame render+readback at the planned resolutions/render distance under llvmpipe and set a hard bound before any capture plan.
- P4 - staging/auth: verify the pinned Prism build's world-open (`-w` undocumented) or a documented alternative; resolve non-interactive auth; only then write a Linux adapter for the two Windows-coupled boundaries (junction -> directory/symlink adapter; DesktopController -> "no operator display / Xvfb display" assertion).
- P5 - only after P1-P4, request a fresh explicit capture GO with exact pins; camera qualification and certified visibility remain separate and UNAVAILABLE.

**Hard blockers.** (a) No renderer/readback certification exists in the pinned pipeline, so cross-renderer pixel fidelity cannot be claimed and strict mode refuses every current capture. (b) WSLg structurally creates operator-session windows. (c) RDP/VM paths require session/VM/host provisioning this assignment forbids, with documented Server-hardware prerequisites for the GL-capable routes. (d) Prism world-open uses an undocumented flag and headless Microsoft auth is unresolved. (e) The Python launcher is Windows-coupled, so a Linux path is new adapter work, not configuration.

**R2 - the float64 envelope is not a demonstrated bound for the implemented source/repository path (blocking to the claimed certificate).** `canonical_roundtrip_error_bound` models model-pixel inverse/forward arithmetic, then runner:123-124 multiplies by the linear scale of inverse A. The observed source errors also contain the separately rounded inverse affine, transformed K, source-coordinate affine application and source homogeneous projection. Those extra operations/translation terms are absent. The repository path additionally computes centre=-R^Tt, point-minus-centre and Euler-reconstructed rotation; its matrix residual is capped but its amplification by ||X||/depth is not in the stated canonical envelope. Raw-delta projection rounding at runner:156 uses norms of the final projected pixels, which is not by itself a rounding bound for homogeneous multiplication/addition when fx*x and cx*z cancel; an explicit sum-of-absolute-operands bound is needed. No concrete real-run underbound is claimed: the implementation/report's coverage claim is unsupported by its derivation. The runner also never compares measured canonical error against the recorded canonical envelope, only each independently against1e-5, so an underestimated envelope may go unnoticed.

### 2026-10-06 23:34 CDT - Astra -> Lead - partial camera admission policy: ACCEPT bounded design; implementation warranted

**Decision.** One ordinary frame lacking a calibration need not invalidate usable estimates from other frames. Recommend explicit partial camera admission, not a relaxed camera validator or silent input deletion. This fixes an integration all-or-nothing policy; it does not prove why this scene's estimator omitted image-0001 or that the surviving views can reconstruct geometry. **Source findings.** `image_only.solve_image_cameras` delegates to `calibration.estimate_session`; that estimator omits first-pass failures and refined-pass failures. `to_camera_solution` retains uncertainty only for returned estimates. `image_derived_session.py:351-368` refuses any omitted frame; its constructor and serializer require camera/local-camera keys exactly equal session.frames. `image_derived_connections._validate_session` repeats that invariant; lattice and entry replay also require exact frame-set equality. Deleting a camera entry or filtering only at the caller is therefore unsafe. `estimate_image_calibrations` already has a different per-frame abstention surface, but switching estimators would change FOV/mask behavior and is outside this fix. In particular, a refined-pass-excluded frame may have contributed to the shared first-pass focal median: exclusion means not used downstream as a calibrated view, NOT no upstream influence. Do not rerun the estimator on a reduced subset or claim that independence.

**Smallest compatible shape.** Version the nested session record (v2), retaining an ordered full input inventory plus typed per-input admission outcomes. Expose the admitted ordered subsequence through the existing session.frames/cameras/local_cameras consumer interface, and expose the full inventory separately (e.g. input_frames). ## Astra source-only audit - tangential translation observability - 2026-10-08
Decision: existing correlation records are potential tangential observations, but their admission/provenance does not establish two reliable metric translation constraints. Do not wire the winning integer peak into G7 or relax its normal-axis connectivity gate. There is already a downstream shift/residue/translation-domain path, but it requires an accepted graph and was not reached in C8. This audit used source reads only: no tests, imports, image/artifact reads, inference, or source edits. Only this requested AGENT_COMMS appendix was written. Paths below are relative to the active repository; R means src/mc_photogrammetry/reconstruction and P means src/mc_photogrammetry/pipeline.

Producer, conventions, and ownership:
- R/lattice.py:738-743 defines the plane normal and the two tangents in increasing remaining axis-label order. R/lattice.py:781-792 constructs points side*n + u*first + v*second. R/lattice_planes.py:2041-2068 selects exactly one retained b alternative and uses that alternative's distance. Its signature origin is floor(centre*distance - extent*distance), its side length is ceil(2*extent*distance), trimmed to max_cells, and the sampled window is reconstructed from that origin and length (2070-2087). Thus origin_uv, cells/coverage, the reading and b belong to PlaneSignature, not PlaneMatch. Coverage requires at least half of the subpixels in a cell (2144-2155). Structural region footprint is retained separately (2157-2201).
- R/plane_graph.py:748-821 defines the right-grid-to-left-grid homography H(j)=P*j+P*o_R-o_L, with P the signed tangent permutation for the relative quadrant. H is already in nominal block-cell units; it must not be multiplied again by distance, focal length or b. R/lattice_planes.py:2380-2418 warps by nearest-neighbor source index. R/plane_graph.py:983-1007 places warped left and right grids on a right-coordinate padded canvas. Its first*conj(second) correlation (874) and witness pair construction (1241-1252) align left sampled at H(j+s) with right j, where s=(column_shift,row_shift).
- PlaneMatch owns endpoint indices/axes/b, relative quadrant, peak, second_peak, PSR, overlap, score, integer_residual and cell_shift_rc (R/plane_graph.py:220-253); index remapping preserves the shift (1471). H itself is reconstructed from signatures, rather than stored in the default PlaneMatch. Optional correlation witnesses retain H and contributing index pairs (1230-1274), but the default graph call supplies no witness sink (P/image_derived_geometry_orchestration.py:305-309; P/image_derived_joint_graph.py:192-199,229-234).

Admission is a cue, not a translation certificate:
- R/plane_graph.py:1090-1106 checks normal/quadrant compatibility and unique requested b alternatives. It selects the highest correlation value among shifts with at least MIN_OVERLAP_CELLS=9 (100,1156-1172), refuses undefined sidelobes, low structural share, or PSR<3 (1175-1198). The peak/second-peak margin only contributes to score (1202-1206); there is no required positive margin or default boundary-peak refusal. PSR uses sidelobe standard deviation and can be positive infinity when that deviation vanishes (904-940). A deterministic argmax is not evidence of unique displacement. For example, equal isolated maxima outside the exclusion window among sufficiently many otherwise low sidelobes can have PSR>3 and zero margin. Periodic shifts, adjacent competing maxima inside the excluded 3x3 neighborhood, repeated motifs on different planes, and truncation at radius32 need separate treatment.
- same_axis_filter uses normal-distance agreement and score, not tangential closure (R/plane_graph.py:1661-1708). The selector binds complete source-row cues, including shift, and keeps distinct admitted evidence groups unresolved (R/endpoint_hypothesis.py:151-159,220-238,313-316,376-379). This does not recover competing peaks already collapsed by match_plane_pair. A signature digest or replay hash proves identity/integrity, not same-physical-plane identity.

Physical model and an unresolved sampling convention:
- Let R_f map local axes to world, E_f embed the two local tangent coordinates, and n_f be the local plane normal. A genuine corresponding point obeys t_R-t_L = R_L*(side_L*d_L*n_L + E_L*x_L) - R_R*(side_R*d_R*n_R + E_R*x_R). Its normal component is the existing signed distance difference (R/plane_graph.py:2196-2207).
- Under the IDEAL nominal unit-cell convention x_L=o_L+H(j+s), x_R=o_R+j, the origins cancel and the tangential contribution is R_L*E_L*P*s = R_R*E_R*s. Hence use column=u, row=v, right absolute-quadrant world sign; do not add the origin displacement again. This is a conditional algebraic model, not a finding that current integer peaks equal physical camera displacement. Fractional translations require residual/subcell evidence or an explicit uncertainty/domain model.
- Source exposes a physical sampling issue that must be tested before exact metric use. R/lattice_planes.py:2083-2087 chooses N=L*S samples over an extent L blocks, while R/lattice.py:786-788 uses endpoint-inclusive linspace. Consecutive S-pixel groups become cells (R/lattice_planes.py:2144-2151). For N>1, analytic sample spacing is L/(N-1), so consecutive group centroids differ by S*L/(L*S-1), not exactly one block; the first centroid is offset from origin by (S-1)*L/[2*(L*S-1)]. H nevertheless uses unit index spacing and origin with no group-centroid offset. Different L/S, reflections, clipping and rounding can therefore matter. This is a source-derived convention discrepancy, NOT a measured reconstruction error; physical synthetic projection/rectification tests must resolve it. Existing manual-array H tests (tests/test_plane_graph.py:1247-1272) establish the chosen algebra, not physical sampling correctness.

Existing consumers and C8 retention:
- G7's evaluator only builds normal equations, calls per-axis lstsq, and discards its returned rank (R/plane_graph.py:2172-2242). It does not consume cell_shift_rc or H. P/image_derived_joint_graph.py:240-250 evaluates geometry only after unique selection; its graph still carries readings, signatures and candidate_matches even when selection is unavailable (100-105,289 onward). Candidate payload hashing includes the shift (P/image_derived_graph.py:399-406; P/image_derived_joint_graph.py:68-80). Thus C8's 100 admitted candidates had live, hash-bound shifts, but zero selected matches/zero evaluator calls as logged. No assertion about their numeric distribution is possible from this audit.
- There ARE downstream tangential consumers. R/plane_residue.py:618-652 copies shifts/support. R/plane_axis_support.py:1057-1088 creates mapped lateral support using right sign*column/row; typed records validate conventions and exact source support (103-168). However P/image_derived_axis_support.py:215-231 requires graph.status='assembled'. R/plane_shift_domain.py:976-1038 retains every searched shift with adequate overlap, plus exact replay/content/geometry/H digests; its replay and budget checks are at803-863,1065 onward. R/plane_vector_domain.py:1219-1235 and1247-1262 uses the richer formula signed_integer_shift + signed_left_residue - signed_right_residue. It explicitly leaves same_physical_plane_lattice, true_local_residues_in_p1b, and true_integer_carries_in_p1d UNVERIFIED (2212-2217). This existing finite-domain approach is closer to a defensible observation model than treating the peak as an exact vector, but is conditional evidence.
- The default orchestration returns immediately on unavailable G (P/image_derived_geometry_orchestration.py:310-311), before axis support312, shift domains318, phase evidence322, vector domains325 and relative translations329. Consequently those tangential consumers were not reached in C8. Simply moving them earlier is not a safe integration: current APIs require an accepted solution/selected identities and must be redesigned to preserve endpoint, q, b, residue and shift ambiguity jointly.
- The published terminal project contains session/source paths, volume and production envelope (P/image_derived_production.py:171-185,200-208); the envelope's joint lineage is digest metadata (P/image_derived_geometry_orchestration.py:46-54). G7 sidecar output carries aggregate incidences and selection proof, not full candidate shifts/H/signature arrays (scripts/evaluation/diagnose_g7_selection_failure.py:430-460). Attrition v2 emits counts/digests (scripts/evaluation/diagnose_image_proposal_attrition_v2.py:493-515), and source pair accounting fields omit shifts (R/plane_graph.py:1049-1066). Therefore the examined default C8 publication path does not persist a reconstructible tangential observation dataset. This conclusion follows from source plus the logged C8 route; no C8 artifact was opened. Hashes cannot recover missing values.

Observability and falsifiable successor design (proposal only, no route/run authorization):
- For N frames, stack independently justified normal and tangential equations and fix only one global 3D translation gauge. Require rank 3*(N-1), an explicit nullspace/conditioning check, and consistency within independently justified measurement bounds. In an axis-separated signed-permutation model, each axis must connect ALL required frames through valid constraints, whether normal or tangential. A trusted full-vector spanning tree can give rank, but gives no redundant check against a wrong correspondence; even full rank and zero cycle residual do not prove identity on repeated texture. - First design an isolated, bounded synthetic mixed-constraint certificate using exact signature sampling geometry and finite shift/residue alternatives. No minimum-norm coordinates may stand in for unobservable values, and no score may select among unresolved physical alternatives. Demonstrate existing complete-axis behavior unchanged and that adding/removing a justified tangent changes rank as predicted. The claim is falsified by any sign/unit failure, lost true-domain member, ambiguity collapse, rank overclaim, bound overrun or changed existing output.
- Only after that source/synthetic review should a separately authorized observational run retain bounded exact candidate/signature provenance needed to test C8-like assignments. C8's aggregate sidecars alone cannot establish which tangential domains would remove its16 connectivity failures, and tangential measurements do not by themselves repair the240 unsupported-endpoint assignments. Astra found that per-row closure is insufficient against resealing: a reached absent-side histogram could be changed with denominator/work and derived counts while its existing seed eligible metric remains zero. 2026-10-10 Luna review - accepted false pair image-0000/image-0005 (read-only; scalar report and source only)

The spatial arm marks this pair solved with 32 selected rows from 301 reciprocal top-k candidate edges, but the independently computed Lowe-ratio survivors are 26 left / 7 right and their mutual intersection is zero. In match_feature_frames, the top-k graph supplies edge_left/edge_right to _class_modes; select_mutual_matches is counted but is not the geometric solver input. The selected pose therefore relies on a descriptor-neighbor graph that had no reciprocal ratio matches. Acceptance thresholds are also only just met: right bins 4 (minimum 4), cheirality 0.75, ambiguity margin 2; support 32 vs floor 8, selected residual 0.4551 deg, parallax 23.248 deg, singular ratio 0.2442. Selected points cluster heavily in one 4x4 cell (cell 9: 17/32 left, 27/32 right). The evaluator deduplicates to 30 unique pairs; same_surface_precision is 0/30 (1 same-state other-block, 4 wrong-surface, 25 unattributed), rotation error 89.607 deg and baseline-direction error 148.364 deg. This falsifies the assumptions that top-k geometric consensus implies reliable visual correspondence, that minimum occupied-bin count means broad spatial support, and that cheirality/low epipolar residual selects the physically correct scene surface. These checks establish internal consistency of a selected mode, not truth.

A multi-view cycle can expose this edge only when an independent alternate path exists. Here the spatial report has one solved edge and zero correct accepted edges across six frames, so there is no cycle witness. Requiring every edge to have a cycle would discard valid sparse bridge/tree edges. The existing image-derived pose-graph composer checks fundamental cycles but refuses the whole composition on a contradiction; it does not isolate the bad chord while preserving a correct sparse forest. A safer future policy would quarantine only a contradicted chord, keep tree edges explicitly unverified, and abstain when no independent path exists. Repeated texture can also create descriptor-track cycles, so a cycle must be checked for unique exact keypoint identity and independent support, not counted as mere closure.

The evaluator's surface verdict is ground-truth-only and cannot become a production gate. A scene-plane check could be useful only after selected endpoint pixels are bound to source-frame usable masks and image-derived region/plane identities; current scalar evidence supplies no such membership. It should abstain on missing/ambiguous labels and avoid rejecting an otherwise valid sparse edge for lack of plane evidence.

Smallest high-value next step: make a post-match, pixels-only audit of the selected correspondences against exact-keypoint three-view tracks already represented by graph_tracks.closed_cycles, and report unique cycle-backed support plus coverage. Evaluate it offline against the existing sealed-pair evaluation labels, including correct sparse edges and this false edge. Treat absence of a third-view witness as unverified, not failed; only contradictory independent cycle evidence may quarantine an edge. Axis/index: no defect found. calibration.axis_directions documents the three world axes in right/up/forward order; vanishing_points emits them in that order. region_growth._segment_support stores line associations in the same enumerated columns; _normal_scores scores normal axis a from the other two support columns; _seed_and_grow uses that same axis for score, side, and tangent support. The six-permutation formula test (tests/test_region_growth.py:858) and axis-symmetric seed tests (tests/test_local_axis_plane_seed_falsifier.py:25) agree. Correct scalar attribution: image-0000 axis0 side -1 max score is 0.1515829563; axis0 side +1 has no side-matched atom (max is null). The 0.1889919937 weak score is image-0000 axis2 side +1, not axis0. Both are below the unchanged 0.26 seed threshold.

Weight coupling: source behavior is real but not a proven bug. _segment_support defaults to structural_weights and adds length * line_weight * sample_fraction * axis_association. _normal_scores then multiplies relative tangent balance and normal absence by absolute reliability tangent/(tangent+24). Uniform scaling preserves the two relative factors but changes reliability; nonuniform structural weights can also change axis ratios. tests/test_region_growth.py:1481 directly demonstrates synthetic sensitivity: one authored line fixture has structural support [1.09339,1.81520,3.96893], score .15158296, tangent mass 5.78413 and no seed; unit weights produce [1.88559,3.13038,15.87572], score .29825294, tangent mass 19.00610 and a seed, with thresholds unchanged. This proves the fixed absolute reliability term can change outcomes under weighting; it does not prove the reliability constant or structural weights are wrong for screenshots. For the 9/12 misses with no same-atom tangent co-occurrence, reweighting cannot create the missing second tangent; their balanced score remains zero. The handoff correctly says these first-fail counts do not prove a visible plane was missed.
